items.title: David Weinstein Interview, 1988-09-22
items.q: And that's where I played with, uh, Skiro. He had that job out there.

ctx.x: a trombone, clarinet. No. What about Schofi and Leon Prima? What kind of band was that?

It was, uh, a dance band. Again, we had three saxes, three brass, and four rhythm. Uh, this was in the day of the open air dance hall. The first one that I remember was the old Frolics on St. Anne Street, just a few feet away from Broad, North Broad. And that's where I played with, uh, Skiro. He had that job out there. The butcher I mentioned. Joe Skiro. And then, uh, I...
Joe Skiro? I'm confused. The guy from, uh, Dauphine and Iberville?
